title: School Management System
tagline: Role-based Java application for academic workflows
intro: University project: Java desktop application with SQLite providing role-based management for students and lecturers.
summary: A Windows desktop application built in Java with SQLite for persistent storage. Implements role-based workflows for course selection, exam scheduling, grade management, and weekly activity planning.
features: Role-based authorization for Students and Lecturers

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A desktop Java application designed for academic institutions to manage courses, exams, schedules, and grades with role-based access for students and lecturers.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a scalable school management tool to streamline scheduling, grading, and communication while enforcing secure role-based access.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Sole developer: designed architecture, implemented UI and database integration, and authored core features for scheduling and grade management.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Built using Java with a local SQLite database. Implemented role-specific flows, CRUD for courses/students, scheduling, and reporting features.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered a fully functional system used as a university milestone project demonstrating Java + DB integration and role-based application design.

confidentialNotes: Public university project; repo available on GitHub.
